top_signals.title: US used ‘virtually all’ long-range precision missiles during Iran war, sources say
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Army has reportedly used up much of its stockpile of highly accurate long-range missiles during America's five-month war with Iran.

top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia tries diplomacy to stop Houthi attacks from growing
top_signals.summary: The kingdom has held talks with the Yemen-based Houthis via Omani mediators and is still preparing military options in case diplomacy fails, sources said.

top_signals.title: Why Michigan voters are hearing 'communist' as they vote Tuesday
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump and Republican allies are escalating attacks that label Democrats communists after progressive candidates won elections and primaries.

top_signals.title: Apple launches new legal challenge against UK over iCloud access
